column1: # Partition table for the v2 master on the N16R8 (16 MB flash)
# IMMUTABLE AFTER FIRST FLASH: the partition table is only ever written over
# USB — an OTA can never move or resize partitions. Shaped deliberately:
#  - offsets are blank on purpose: gen_esp32part auto-places each partition
#    with the correct alignment (4 KB data
#    offsets are where table bugs come from. Expected placement: nvs 0x9000
#    otadata 0x19000
#    storage 0x830000 (verified against the built partitions.bin).
#  - nvs 64 KB: top of Espressif's recommended 12–64 KB range — wear
#    leveling spreads erases across pages

column1: #    up degrades quickly (ESP-IDF file-system guidance).
#  - app slots 4 MB each: ~7x the current firmware incl. PROGMEM web assets;
#    the OTA pair is what actually needs guaranteed room (default_16MB.csv
#    would give 6.4 MB slots + a 3.4 MB SPIFFS we'd never mount). Bootloader
#    app rollback (custom_sdkconfig) needs only these two slots + otadata.
#  - coredump 64 KB: post-mortem backtraces without a debugger attached.
#  - storage ~7.8 MB: everything left
#    costs nothing; formattable later (LittleFS/FAT) for log archives or
#    staged unit firmware without touching app offsets. Subtype `spiffs` is
#    the conventional "generic FS-capable data" marker; nothing mounts it.
